question: Should OpenClaw add bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets now, and what source, scope, redaction, retention, and export boundary should they use?
rationale: Current main has log-tail and terminal output primitives, but exposing them in persistent dashboard cells is a new security-sensitive product surface and depends on dashboard substrate and binding decisions.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model first, then implement widgets against approved contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Read-Only Primitives
options.body: Allow only widgets over existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command or terminal output, excluding new command execution and generic command bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Widgets
options.body: Keep this as roadmap context and route contributors toward external plugins or missing plugin APIs until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model first, then implement widgets against approved contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The log-tail contract and security/product boundary are closest to the current merged log-tail history.
